text: {"lessons":["I sold Stocks A, C and D after gains, even though my account was down that month; I should judge decisions by their future prospects and my overall plan, not just whether each position is above its average cost.","Treating each stock as a separate account can make me reluctant to admit a losing purchase. I should review all positions consistently and be willing to change my view when the facts change.","I rarely trade, so I should set clear allocation and risk limits in advance, review them periodically, and avoid reacting to short-term account swings."]}
